title: Order or instability? Rosas, Carrera and Sarmiento's Facundo
goal: Read how people judged the caudillos, and use reported speech to say what each side said and wrote.

items: Use reported speech (*dijo que*, *escribió que*) to say what people said and wrote about the caudillos.
Say what the defenders of Rosas said.
Say what Sarmiento wrote in Facundo (1845).
Say why Rafael Carrera does not fit Sarmiento's idea.
Use the key words of this lesson: civilization, barbarism, writer, exiled, defender and instability.
